generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every deviation from template standard language is logged for legal approval.
generic.Test population: The generated draft agreement plus all attached exhibits.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any non-standard clause exists without a logged legal approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-standard language routes to Legal Counsel before the draft can be issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Draft is accepted when generated from the approved template with matching exhibits.
generic.Evidence location: Contract lifecycle management repository draft linked to the producer record.

steps.title: Select the current approved template in the CLM repository
sop: Select the producer or agency agreement template for the entity type and jurisdiction.
Confirm the template carries current approval and note its version.
Done when the correct current template version is selected.
verify: Compare the template version to the published approved version list.
Pass when the selected template is the current approved version.

steps.title: Populate entity and territory data from the producer master record
sop: Populate legal entity name, FEIN and effective date from the producer master.
Populate the territory and the appointed lines of authority.
Done when all entity and territory fields are populated from source.
verify: Compare populated identity fields to the producer master record.
Pass when the draft fields match the master record exactly.

steps.title: Attach the commission schedule exhibit with approved rates
sop: Attach the commission schedule exhibit with rates by line and by new or renewal.
Compare every rate against the approved recommendation memo.
Done when the exhibit is attached with memo-matching rates.
verify: Recheck each exhibit rate line against the approved memo rate.
Pass when every rate matches the approved memo.

steps.title: Set the binding authority terms in the draft
sop: Set authority limits by line and the referral thresholds.
List the prohibited classes applicable to the producer.
Done when limits, thresholds and prohibited classes are set.
verify: Compare authority limits to the approved recommendation memo.
Pass when limits and thresholds match the approved memo.

steps.title: Flag deviations from template standard language
sop: Compare the draft against the template baseline and mark each variance.
Log every deviation with its rationale on the contract record.
Done when every deviation is logged with a rationale.
verify: Run the template comparison and list unlogged variances.
Pass when no variance is unlogged.

steps.title: Route flagged deviations to Legal Counsel for approval
sop: Review each flagged deviation against carrier legal policy.
Approve, amend or reject each deviation and record the decision.
Confirm no unapproved non-standard clause remains in the draft.
Done when every deviation carries a recorded legal decision.
verify: List non-standard clauses without a logged legal approval.
Pass when that list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: The assigned field or agency manager covering the newly contracted producer territory.
generic.In-scope period: Notification issued within the agreed window after agreement execution.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Producer code, effective date, appointed states and authority limits are stated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: States listed in the notification equal the appointed states on the producer record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The notification is logged with recipients and timestamp on the producer record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undeliverable notifications are logged and resent to a confirmed manager address.
generic.Test population: All executed-agreement notifications issued for the producer.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the notification omits producer code, effective date or appointed states.
generic.Exception handling path: Unassigned territories route to the Agency Relations Manager for manager assignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notification is complete when logged against both producer record and contracting case.
generic.Evidence location: Producer record activity log and the CRM record for the territory.

steps.title: Identify the assigned field manager from the territory assignment
sop: Read the servicing territory on the producer master record.
Identify the field or agency manager assigned to that territory.
Done when the assigned field manager is identified by name.
verify: Cross-check the manager against the CRM territory assignment.
Pass when producer system and CRM name the same manager.

steps.title: Draft the executed-agreement notification
sop: State the producer code, agreement effective date and appointed states.
Confirm each stated value against the producer master record.
Done when the draft states code, effective date and appointed states.
verify: Compare the stated states to the appointment record.
Pass when stated states equal the appointed states.

steps.title: Add commission summary and binding authority limits
sop: Summarise the agreed commission schedule by line in the notification.
State the binding authority limits and referral thresholds.
Done when commission summary and authority limits are included.
verify: Compare the summary values to the executed agreement exhibits.
Pass when the summary matches the executed exhibits.

steps.title: List outstanding pre-activation items with owners
sop: List outstanding licensing, portal access and training items.
Name the owner and target date for each outstanding item.
Done when every outstanding item has an owner and target date.
verify: Compare the listed items to the open items on the contracting case.
Pass when no open case item is omitted from the list.

steps.title: Send the notification via Microsoft Teams or email
sop: Send the notification to the assigned field manager and copy the relationship team.
Capture the send timestamp and recipient list.
Done when the notification is sent and the timestamp is captured.
verify: Check the send confirmation and recipient list.
Pass when the assigned field manager appears as a recipient.

steps.title: Log the notification on the producer record and contracting case
sop: Log the notification against the producer record in the producer system.
Log the same notification against the contracting case.
Confirm the logged content matches what was sent.
Done when the notification is logged in both places.
verify: Open the producer record log and read the notification entry.
Pass when the entry names producer code and effective date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The single execution-ready agreement version and its complete exhibit set.
generic.In-scope period: The legal review cycle ending at version lock for signature.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Version number, lock status and exhibit list are populated on the contract record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exhibit count on the final version equals the required exhibit list count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The locked version carries its version number and lock timestamp in the repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any residual legal comment is logged with an accept or resolve disposition.
generic.Test population: The final version, the last approved draft and the redline comparison output.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any open redline or unresolved legal comment remains at lock.
generic.Exception handling path: Unincorporated redlines return the version to draft for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Version is execution-ready when locked with all exhibits and zero open redlines.
generic.Evidence location: Contract lifecycle management repository version history for the producer contract.

steps.title: Confirm legal review is closed on the contract record
sop: Open the contract record and read the legal review status.
Confirm no open redline or unanswered comment remains.
Done when the review status is closed with zero open items.
verify: List open redlines and comments on the contract record.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Retrieve the final version from the CLM repository
sop: Retrieve the latest version marked final from the contract repository.
Note the version number on the producer record.
Done when the final version and its number are retrieved and noted.
verify: Compare the noted version number to the repository version history.
Pass when the noted number is the latest final version.

steps.title: Diff the final version against the last approved draft
sop: Run a document comparison between the final version and the last approved draft.
Confirm every agreed redline is incorporated and no new change appears.
Done when the comparison shows only agreed changes.
verify: Review the comparison output for unagreed differences.
Pass when the output contains no unagreed difference.

steps.title: Confirm all exhibits are attached to the final version
sop: Confirm the commission schedule, territory and binding authority exhibits are attached.
Confirm each exhibit is the version matching the approved terms.
Done when all required exhibits are attached at the correct versions.
verify: Count attached exhibits against the required exhibit list.
Pass when every required exhibit is attached.

steps.title: Mark superseded drafts obsolete in the repository
sop: Mark every earlier draft version as obsolete in the contract repository.
Confirm obsolete versions are excluded from the signature-ready view.
Done when all earlier drafts are marked obsolete.
verify: Search the repository for drafts still available as current.
Pass when only the final version shows as current.

steps.title: Lock the execution-ready version for signature
sop: Lock the final version so no further edits are possible.
Record the lock timestamp and the approving counsel on the contract record.
Confirm the locked version is the one released to DocuSign.
Done when the version is locked and the lock is recorded.
verify: Read the lock status and approving counsel on the contract record.
Pass when the version is locked with a named approving counsel.

generic.Defined scope/population: Portal access and writing authority for the producer across confirmed appointed states.
generic.In-scope period: Provisioning effective from the agreement effective date onward.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Role profile, authority limits by line and enabled state list are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Enabled states equal the states with confirmed active appointments.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The access grant date and approver are recorded on the producer record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any state enabled ahead of appointment confirmation is logged and removed.
generic.Test population: All configured authority lines and enabled states for the producer.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if portal authority exceeds the executed agreement exhibit on any line.
generic.Exception handling path: Authority discrepancies route to the Distribution Operations Manager for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Access is accepted when a test login shows only permitted lines and states.
generic.Evidence location: IAM platform access record and the Broker & Agent Portal configuration log.

steps.title: Confirm licence and appointment gates are green
sop: Read licence verification and appointment confirmation on the producer record.
Stop provisioning if either gate is not confirmed.
Done when both gates are confirmed green on the producer record.
verify: Re-read both gate statuses immediately before provisioning.
Pass when both statuses remain confirmed at provisioning time.

steps.title: Create the portal account and assign the role profile in the IAM platform
sop: Create the producer portal account in the IAM platform.
Assign the role profile matching the agreed lines and authority level.
Done when the account exists with the correct role profile assigned.
verify: Read the assigned role profile against the agreed authority level.
Pass when the profile matches the agreed authority level.

steps.title: Set writing authority limits per line in the distribution system
sop: Enter the authority limit for each line from the executed agreement exhibit.
Set referral thresholds and prohibited classes per line.
Done when every line carries the exhibit authority limit.
verify: Compare each configured limit to the executed exhibit line by line.
Pass when configured limits equal exhibit limits on every line.

steps.title: Restrict portal state access to confirmed appointed states
sop: Enable only the states with a confirmed active appointment.
Remove any state enabled by default that lacks confirmation.
Done when enabled states equal the confirmed appointment list.
verify: Compare the enabled state list to the confirmed appointment list.
Pass when no enabled state lacks a confirmed appointment.

steps.title: Run a portal test login and confirm visible scope
sop: Perform a test login using the provisioned producer role.
Confirm only permitted lines and states are visible in the portal.
Record any excess visibility as a defect for correction.
Done when the test login shows only permitted lines and states.
verify: List any line or state visible beyond the approved scope.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Record the access grant date and approver
sop: Record the access grant date and the approving manager on the producer record.
Link the IAM access record to the producer record.
Done when grant date, approver and IAM link are recorded.
verify: Open the producer record and read the grant date and approver.
Pass when both are populated and the IAM link resolves.

generic.Defined scope/population: The contracted producer file being assessed for release into activation.
generic.In-scope period: Statuses current and unexpired as at the release decision date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Agreement, W-9, EFT, E&O, licences, appointments and commission setup are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Producer code and hierarchy setup reconcile to the executed agreement terms.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Release status is stored with the releasing manager name and release date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open hold flags and exceptions are listed with owner and disposition before release.
generic.Test population: Every item on the contracting completeness checklist for this producer.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if release is recorded while any hold flag or exception remains open.
generic.Exception handling path: Open exceptions block release until cleared or formally waived with approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Released for Activation requires all checks cleared and unexpired.
generic.Evidence location: Producer record in the agency/producer management system and the contracting case.

steps.title: Run the contracting completeness check on the producer file
sop: Check the executed agreement, W-9, EFT form and E&O certificate are present.
Check licence copies and appointment confirmations are present for every state.
Done when every completeness item is confirmed present.
verify: Count present items against the completeness checklist items.
Pass when every checklist item is present.

steps.title: Confirm compliance statuses are cleared and unexpired
sop: Read licence verification, watchlist screening and background-check statuses.
Confirm each is Cleared and within its validity window.
Done when all three statuses are cleared and unexpired.
verify: Check each status expiry date against the release date.
Pass when no status has expired at the release date.

steps.title: Confirm producer code, hierarchy and commission setup reconcile
sop: Confirm the producer code exists and the hierarchy node is set.
Compare the commission setup against the executed schedule exhibit.
Done when code, hierarchy and commission setup are confirmed.
verify: Recompare configured commission rates to the executed exhibit.
Pass when configured rates equal the exhibit rates.

steps.title: Confirm no open hold flag on the producer record
sop: List all hold flags and unresolved exceptions on the producer record.
Require closure or documented waiver for each before release.
Done when no hold flag or unresolved exception remains.
verify: Re-run the hold flag query on the producer record.
Pass when the query returns zero open flags.

steps.title: Set status Released for Activation in the producer system
sop: Set the producer status to Released for Activation.
Record the releasing manager name and the release date.
Done when the status, releasing manager and date are recorded.
verify: Read back the status, manager and date on the producer record.
Pass when all three values are populated.

steps.title: Close the contracting case in the workflow tool
sop: Attach the completeness evidence to the contracting case.
Close the case with a release note referencing the producer record.
Done when the contracting case is closed with the release note.
verify: Confirm the closed case references a Released for Activation status.
Pass when the case closure references the release status.

generic.Defined scope/population: The draft producer agreement and all requested deviations submitted for legal review.
generic.In-scope period: The legal review SLA window from request creation to review closure.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Entity name, territory, lines, expected premium and deviation list are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Deviations attached equal the deviations logged on the contract record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The review record carries reviewer, review date and approval status.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Approved-with-conditions outcomes log each condition and its owner.
generic.Test population: The submitted draft and every attached deviation request.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an agreement proceeds to signature without a closed legal review status.
generic.Exception handling path: SLA breaches escalate per the agreed legal escalation threshold.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Review is closed when status is Approved or Approved-with-conditions with conditions logged.
generic.Evidence location: Contract record in the CLM repository with the linked workflow review case.

steps.title: Create the legal review request on the contract record
sop: Create the review request with entity name, territory, lines and expected premium.
Link the request to the workflow case management record.
Done when the review request exists and is linked to the case.
verify: Read the request fields against the producer master record.
Pass when request fields match the producer master.

steps.title: Attach the draft, schedule and deviations from the document repository
sop: Attach the draft agreement and the commission schedule exhibit.
Attach every requested deviation from standard language.
Done when draft, schedule and all deviations are attached.
verify: Count attached deviations against those logged on the contract record.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Flag high-risk term requests for explicit legal comment
sop: Flag any non-standard binding authority, indemnity or termination request.
State the business reason for each flagged request.
Done when every high-risk request is flagged with a reason.
verify: List high-risk requests without a flag or reason.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Review the agreement against carrier legal policy
sop: Review the draft, schedule and each flagged deviation.
Record comments and redlines directly on the contract record.
Done when every attached item has a recorded legal comment or clearance.
verify: List attached items with no legal comment or clearance.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Track the review against the SLA and escalate at threshold
sop: Track elapsed review time against the agreed legal SLA.
Chase at the escalation threshold and record the chase on the case.
Done when the review is within SLA or an escalation is recorded.
verify: Compare elapsed days to the agreed SLA duration.
Pass when within SLA or an escalation entry exists.

steps.title: Close the review with status and logged conditions
sop: Set the review status to Approved or Approved-with-conditions.
Log each condition with its owner and required action.
Record reviewer name and review date on the contract record.
Done when the review status, conditions, reviewer and date are recorded.
verify: Confirm no agreement moves to signature with an open review status.
Pass when signature only follows a closed review status.

generic.Defined scope/population: The new producer code and every sub-producer node attached beneath it.
generic.In-scope period: Hierarchy effective from the agreement effective date onward.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Parent node, hierarchy effective date and commission roll-up path are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sub-producer codes attached equal the writing individuals on the agreement.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The hierarchy validation report is retained with its run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Orphan or circular nodes are logged with the corrective action taken.
generic.Test population: The new producer node and all nodes on its roll-up path.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the validation report shows any orphan or circular relationship.
generic.Exception handling path: Structure ambiguities route to the Distribution Operations Manager for a ruling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Hierarchy is accepted when the roll-up path pays the correct payee in test.
generic.Evidence location: Hierarchy configuration in Duck Creek Distribution and the billing platform.

steps.title: Confirm the agency structure from the executed agreement
sop: Read the agency and sub-agency structure from the executed agreement.
Identify any MGA or aggregator parent relationship stated.
Done when the intended hierarchy structure is documented.
verify: Compare the documented structure to the agreement text.
Pass when the documented structure matches the agreement.

steps.title: Link the producer code to its parent node in Duck Creek Distribution
sop: Attach the new producer code to the correct parent agency node.
Set the hierarchy effective date to the agreement effective date.
Done when the code is attached with an effective date.
verify: Read the parent node and effective date on the saved record.
Pass when both match the intended structure.

steps.title: Attach writing sub-producer codes to the correct nodes
sop: Create or attach each writing individual sub-producer code.
Place each under the correct agency node in the hierarchy.
Done when every writing individual is attached to a node.
verify: Count attached sub-producer codes against writing individuals on the agreement.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Set the commission roll-up path in the billing/commission platform
sop: Set the roll-up path so override and parent commissions reach the correct payee.
Confirm the payee entity matches the executed agreement payee.
Done when the roll-up path and payee are configured.
verify: Run a sample override calculation on the configured path.
Pass when the override credits the agreement payee.

steps.title: Run the hierarchy validation report
sop: Run the hierarchy validation report for the new producer subtree.
Correct any orphan node or circular parent relationship reported.
Done when the report returns no orphan or circular finding.
verify: Re-run the validation report after corrections.
Pass when the report is clean for the new producer.

steps.title: Review and sign off the hierarchy configuration
sop: Review the parent linkage, sub-producer placement and roll-up path.
Confirm the structure matches the executed agreement.
Record hierarchy sign-off on the producer record.
Done when a dated hierarchy sign-off is recorded.
verify: Confirm the signed-off structure has a valid roll-up path.
Pass when sign-off coexists with a clean validation report.

generic.Defined scope/population: The fully executed producer agreement and its appointment confirmation records.
generic.In-scope period: Retention runs from the agreement effective date per the contract retention class.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Producer code, effective date, notice period, renewal flag and territory are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Filed appointment records equal the confirmed appointment states.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The stored file includes the signature audit certificate and filing timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any metadata field left blank is logged with an owner and completion date.
generic.Test population: The executed agreement, its exhibits and all appointment confirmations.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an unsigned or draft version is stored as the contract of record.
generic.Exception handling path: Incorrect or draft filings are withdrawn and refiled with the executed version.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Filing is accepted when retrievable by producer code with retention applied.
generic.Evidence location: Contract lifecycle management repository producer folder in OpenText Document Mgmt.

steps.title: Confirm the file is the fully executed version
sop: Open the file and confirm both party signatures are present.
Confirm the signature audit certificate is included in the package.
Done when the executed version and certificate are confirmed.
verify: Check the document status is executed rather than draft.
Pass when the status is executed and the certificate is present.

steps.title: File the agreement under the producer entity in the CLM repository
sop: File the agreement under the producer entity folder.
Set the contract type to Producer Agreement.
Done when the agreement is filed with the correct contract type.
verify: Search the repository for the producer entity folder.
Pass when the agreement appears under the correct entity.

steps.title: Populate the contract metadata fields
sop: Populate producer code, effective date and termination notice period.
Populate the renewal or auto-renew flag and the territory.
Done when all five metadata fields are populated.
verify: List metadata fields left blank on the stored contract.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: File the appointment confirmations alongside the agreement
sop: File the appointment confirmation records in the same producer folder.
Confirm one confirmation is filed for every confirmed state.
Done when appointment confirmations for all states are filed.
verify: Count filed confirmations against the confirmed appointment states.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Apply the contract retention class in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Apply the contract retention class to the filed agreement folder.
Confirm the retention start date is the agreement effective date.
Done when the retention class and start date are applied.
verify: Read the retention class and start date on the stored record.
Pass when both are set as required by the retention policy.

steps.title: Confirm retrievability and record-of-truth status
sop: Search the repository by producer code and by FEIN.
Confirm the executed version returns as the contract of record.
Confirm no draft version returns as current.
Done when the executed version is confirmed as the record of truth.
verify: Repeat the search and inspect the returned version status.
Pass when only the executed version is returned as current.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every licensed individual attached to the producer whose CE status affects licence validity.
generic.In-scope period: The current state CE compliance period for each licensed individual.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Credit hours, ethics credits and CE deadline date are populated per individual.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: CE records checked equal the licensed individual count on the producer file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The PDB CE status is recorded with its retrieval date per individual.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Individuals short of credits are logged with a chase notice and deadline.
generic.Test population: All licensed individuals on the producer file, not a sample.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a licensed individual has no dated CE status recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: CE deficiencies within 60 days of deadline trigger a chase and authority review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: CE verification is complete when every individual carries a dated outcome.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository CE extracts linked to individual producer records.

steps.title: Retrieve CE compliance status from the NIPR PDB
sop: Query the PDB for CE status for each licensed individual by NPN.
Capture the response with its retrieval date.
Done when CE status is retrieved for every licensed individual.
verify: Count retrieved CE records against the licensed individual list.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Compare credit hours against each resident state requirement
sop: Read the required credit hours for each individual resident state.
Compare recorded credits against the requirement for the current period.
Done when each individual has a credit sufficiency result.
verify: Spot-check three individuals against the published state requirement.
Pass when the sampled comparisons are correct.

steps.title: Confirm state-specific ethics and product training credits
sop: Check ethics credit requirements per state are satisfied.
Check annuity or long-term care training credits where the state requires them.
Done when specialist credit requirements are checked per individual.
verify: List individuals with an unmet specialist credit requirement.
Pass when every such individual carries an open exception.

steps.title: Flag individuals within 60 days of a CE deadline
sop: Identify individuals within 60 days of a CE deadline with insufficient credits.
Raise a chase notice with the specific shortfall and deadline.
Done when every at-risk individual has a chase notice raised.
verify: Count chase notices against at-risk individuals identified.
Pass when every at-risk individual has a notice.

steps.title: Issue the chase notices to producers
sop: Send each chase notice to the individual and copy the agency principal.
Record the notice send date on the individual producer record.
Done when every chase notice is sent and recorded.
verify: Read the recorded send dates on the individual records.
Pass when each raised notice has a recorded send date.

steps.title: Record the CE verification outcome per individual
sop: Record the CE verification date and outcome on each individual record.
Flag authority review where a deficiency passes the state deadline.
Done when every individual carries a dated CE outcome.
verify: List individuals with a CE deficiency retaining active writing authority.
Pass when that list is empty past the state deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every contracted state and product line pair on the agreement territory exhibit.
generic.In-scope period: Licence records active as at the coverage confirmation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State, line of authority, licence status and match result are populated per pair.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Matrix pair count equals the contracted state and line pair count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The PDB licence extract is retained with its retrieval timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmatched pairs are logged as gap items with owner and target resolution date.
generic.Test population: All contracted state and line pairs, not a sample.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an unmatched pair exists without an open gap item.
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps route to the credential coordination task until the licence is live.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Coverage is confirmed when each contracted pair maps to an active licence line.
generic.Evidence location: Producer file coverage matrix in the agency/producer management system.

steps.title: List contracted states and lines from the territory exhibit
sop: Read each contracted state and product line from the agreement exhibit.
Build the state and line pair list on the producer file.
Done when the contracted pair list is complete.
verify: Count listed pairs against the exhibit states and lines.
Pass when the pair list covers the full exhibit.

steps.title: Pull the PDB licence record from NIPR
sop: Query the PDB and list every active licence by state.
Record the lines of authority held under each licence.
Done when active licences and lines are listed from the PDB.
verify: Check the PDB extract carries a retrieval timestamp.
Pass when the extract is timestamped and complete.

steps.title: Match each contracted pair to an active licence line
sop: Compare each contracted state and line pair to the PDB lines of authority.
Mark each pair matched or unmatched on the coverage matrix.
Done when every contracted pair carries a match result.
verify: List contracted pairs without a match result.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Confirm non-resident licences for out-of-state coverage
sop: Identify contracted states that are non-resident for the producer.
Confirm an active non-resident licence exists for each.
Done when non-resident coverage is confirmed for every such state.
verify: List non-resident states with no active licence.
Pass when every such state carries an open gap item.

steps.title: Record the coverage confirmation on the producer file
sop: Store the completed state-by-line coverage matrix on the producer file.
Record the confirmation date and the verifying analyst.
Done when the matrix, date and verifier are stored.
verify: Open the producer file and read the matrix and confirmation date.
Pass when both are present and dated.

steps.title: Open gap items for every unmatched pair
sop: Create a gap item for each unmatched state and line pair.
Assign an owner and a target resolution date to each gap item.
Done when every unmatched pair has an owned gap item.
verify: Count gap items against unmatched pairs on the matrix.
Pass when the counts agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open licence gap items requiring new or amended credentials for this producer.
generic.In-scope period: From gap identification until the credential shows active at the regulator.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Missing state, required line of authority, fee and chase date are populated per gap.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closed gap items equal the credentials confirmed live in the PDB.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The PDB re-query evidence is retained with its retrieval timestamp per gap.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Producer refusals or delays are logged with the escalation taken.
generic.Test population: Every open licence gap item on the producer file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a gap item closes on a producer-supplied copy without PDB confirmation.
generic.Exception handling path: Stalled credentials escalate to the Producer Compliance Manager for authority action.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Gap closure requires the PDB to show the line active at the regulator.
generic.Evidence location: Gap items on the producer record with attached PDB extracts.

steps.title: Issue the written credential request to the producer
sop: List each missing licence, state and required line of authority.
Send the request to the agency principal and record the send date.
Done when the written request is sent and recorded.
verify: Compare listed items to the open gap items on the producer file.
Pass when every open gap appears in the request.

steps.title: Provide the NIPR application route and fee per state
sop: Provide the NIPR non-resident application route for each missing state.
State the current fee amount for each application.
Done when route and fee are provided for every missing state.
verify: Compare quoted fees to the current NIPR fee schedule.
Pass when quoted fees match the current schedule.

steps.title: Set and work the chase cadence
sop: Set the agreed chase interval on each open gap item.
Follow up at each interval and record the contact outcome.
Escalate gaps with no producer response after two chases.
Done when each gap item carries a current chase record.
verify: List gap items with no chase activity past the interval.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Re-query the PDB on receipt of each credential
sop: Query the PDB for the new licence or amended line of authority.
Confirm the regulator shows the line active with an effective date.
Done when the PDB confirms the credential is live.
verify: Read the PDB status and effective date for the credential.
Pass when the PDB shows the line active.

steps.title: Close the gap item and update the coverage matrix
sop: Close the gap item only against a confirming PDB extract.
Update the coverage matrix pair from unmatched to matched.
Done when the gap is closed and the matrix is updated.
verify: Check every closed gap has an attached PDB extract.
Pass when no closure relies on a producer-supplied copy alone.

steps.title: Report residual gaps and their impact on authority
sop: List gaps still open past their target resolution date.
Recommend authority restriction where the gap blocks writing.
Record the recommendation on the producer record.
Done when every overdue gap carries a recorded recommendation.
verify: List overdue gaps without a recorded recommendation.
Pass when that list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: The completed licence verification for this producer across all contracted states.
generic.In-scope period: Verification current at the documented verification date until the next re-verification.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Outcome, verification date, verifier name, states, lines and next date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: States documented equal the states covered by the verification exercise.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The PDB extract used is attached showing its retrieval timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Granted exceptions record the approver and the exception expiry date.
generic.Test population: The verification record and its attached evidence for this producer.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the record lacks a dated PDB extract or a next re-verification date.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed verifications route immediately to the licence hold flag task.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Documentation is accepted when outcome, evidence, verifier and next date all exist.
generic.Evidence location: Producer record in the agency/producer management system and evidence repository.

steps.title: Record the verification outcome on the producer record
sop: Record the outcome as Verified, Gap or Failed on the producer record.
Record the verification date alongside the outcome.
Done when the outcome and verification date are recorded.
verify: Read back the outcome and date on the producer record.
Pass when both fields are populated.

steps.title: Attach the PDB extract used as evidence
sop: Attach the PDB extract to the producer record in the document repository.
Confirm the extract shows the retrieval timestamp.
Done when the timestamped extract is attached.
verify: Open the attached extract and read the retrieval timestamp.
Pass when the timestamp is present and legible.

steps.title: Record verifier name and covered states and lines
sop: Record the name of the analyst who performed the verification.
Record the states and lines covered by the verification.
Done when verifier, states and lines are recorded.
verify: Compare recorded states to the contracted state list.
Pass when all contracted states are covered or gaps are noted.

steps.title: Record any granted exception with approver and expiry
sop: Record each exception granted during verification.
Record its approver name and its expiry date.
Done when every exception carries approver and expiry.
verify: List exceptions without an approver or expiry date.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Set the next scheduled re-verification date
sop: Calculate the next re-verification date from the verification policy.
Set the date on the producer record so monitoring picks it up.
Done when the next re-verification date is set.
verify: Compare the set date to the policy re-verification interval.
Pass when the date matches the policy interval.

steps.title: File the verification pack in the compliance evidence repository
sop: File the outcome record, extract and exception notes as one evidence pack.
Link the pack to the producer record for retrieval.
Done when the evidence pack is filed and linked.
verify: Retrieve the pack from the producer record link.
Pass when the pack returns outcome, extract, verifier and next date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All producers whose licence status or lines no longer support contracted writing authority.
generic.In-scope period: Licence statuses as at the current monitoring run date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Gap reason code, resolution owner, target date and escalation date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Hold flags applied equal the licence gaps identified in the run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each hold flag records the applying user and the application timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Producers exempted from hold are logged with the approver and rationale.
generic.Test population: Every producer with an expired, lapsed, suspended or mismatched licence.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a flagged producer retains writing authority in an affected state.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed gaps route to the Producer Compliance Manager before the hold is lifted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Flagging is complete when every gap carries a hold flag with owner and date.
generic.Evidence location: Hold flags on the producer master and cases in the workflow management tool.

steps.title: Identify producers with licence gaps from the monitoring output
sop: List producers whose licence is expired, lapsed, cancelled or suspended.
List producers whose licensed lines no longer cover contracted authority.
Done when the full gap population is identified.
verify: Recount the gap population against the monitoring sweep exceptions.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Apply the licensing hold flag on the producer master
sop: Apply the licensing hold flag to each identified producer record.
Record the specific gap reason code on the flag.
Done when every identified producer carries a coded hold flag.
verify: Count hold flags applied against the identified gap population.
Pass when every gap producer carries a hold flag.

steps.title: Suppress writing authority in the Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Suppress new-business writing authority for the affected states and lines.
Leave unaffected states and lines untouched.
Done when suppression covers only the affected states and lines.
verify: Test the portal scope for a flagged producer.
Pass when no affected state retains active writing authority.

steps.title: Create the resolution case in the workflow tool
sop: Create a resolution case per hold with the gap detail attached.
Record the resolution owner, target date and escalation date.
Done when each hold has an owned resolution case.
verify: List holds without an owned resolution case.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Notify the field manager and the producer
sop: Notify the assigned field manager of the hold scope and reason.
Notify the producer of the remediation required to lift the hold.
Log both notifications against the hold case.
Done when both notifications are sent and logged.
verify: Read the notification log entries on the hold case.
Pass when both notifications appear with timestamps.

steps.title: Review the flagged population for completeness
sop: Review the flagged list against the licence gap population.
Confirm every flag carries reason code, owner and target date.
Done when the review confirms complete and coded flagging.
verify: Run the hold flag report for missing owners or target dates.
Pass when the report returns zero incomplete flags.

generic.Defined scope/population: The agency entity and every licensed individual whose regulatory history is reviewed.
generic.In-scope period: Full available regulatory action history at the review date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Action type, state, date and licence impact are recorded for every finding.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reviewed parties equal the entity plus its licensed individual count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: PDB history extracts and bulletin checks are retained with retrieval dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Serious findings are logged with escalation to compliance leadership.
generic.Test population: All administrative actions returned for the entity and its individuals.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a producer with an unresolved revocation is left in Verified status.
generic.Exception handling path: Fraud or misappropriation findings escalate before any appointment proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Review closes with a documented conclusion, reviewer and date.
generic.Evidence location: Producer record in the agency/producer management system with attached extracts.

steps.title: Pull the PDB regulatory action history from NIPR
sop: Pull the regulatory action section of the PDB for the agency and each individual.
Capture the extract with its retrieval date.
Done when history extracts exist for the entity and all individuals.
verify: Count extracts against the licensed individual list plus the entity.
Pass when every party has an extract.

steps.title: Review each administrative action for type and licence impact
sop: Record type, state and date for each administrative action found.
Record whether the licence was suspended or revoked in each case.
Done when every action carries type, state, date and impact.
verify: List actions missing type, state, date or impact.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Check state DOI enforcement bulletins via LexisNexis Risk
sop: Search state DOI enforcement bulletins for actions not yet in the PDB.
Record any additional action found with its source and date.
Done when bulletin checks are complete for every licensed state.
verify: List licensed states with no bulletin check recorded.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Assess severity and escalate serious findings
sop: Assess whether any finding involves misappropriation, misrepresentation or unlicensed activity.
Escalate every such finding to compliance leadership with a legal opinion.
Record the escalation and the legal view on the producer record.
Done when every serious finding carries an escalation and legal view.
verify: List serious findings without an escalation record.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Document the review conclusion on the producer record
sop: Record the conclusion as No Adverse History, Adverse Accepted with Conditions or Adverse Decline.
Record the reviewer name and the review date.
Done when the conclusion, reviewer and date are recorded.
verify: Read the conclusion, reviewer and date on the producer record.
Pass when all three are populated.

steps.title: Check no unresolved revocation remains in Verified status
sop: Cross-check the licence verification status against the review conclusion.
Downgrade any Verified status where a revocation or fraud action is unresolved.
Done when statuses are consistent with the review conclusions.
verify: List producers in Verified status with an unresolved adverse action.
Pass when that list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: The E&O certificate covering the contracting agency entity for this appointment.
generic.In-scope period: The E&O policy period covering the intended activation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Insured name, per-claim limit, aggregate limit, retention and expiry are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recorded limits equal the limits stated on the certificate.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The certificate is filed with its receipt date and policy period.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Below-minimum limits are logged with the waiver decision and approver.
generic.Test population: The current E&O certificate and its stated coverage terms.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if limits fall below the published minimum for the producer segment.
generic.Exception handling path: Deficient coverage blocks activation until a compliant certificate is received.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation passes when limits, period and retention all meet requirements.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository certificate linked to the producer record.

steps.title: Confirm the certificate names the contracting entity
sop: Read the named insured on the E&O certificate.
Compare it to the contracting agency legal name on the agreement.
Done when the named insured is confirmed to match the agreement entity.
verify: Re-read both names character by character.
Pass when the named insured equals the agreement entity name.

steps.title: Compare limits against the published carrier minimum
sop: Read the per-claim and aggregate limits from the certificate.
Compare each to the published minimum for the producer segment.
Done when both limits are compared and the result is recorded.
verify: Recheck the segment minimum used against the published table.
Pass when both limits meet or exceed the segment minimum.

steps.title: Confirm the policy is in force at the activation date
sop: Read the policy inception and expiry dates from the certificate.
Confirm the intended activation date falls inside the policy period.
Done when in-force status at activation is confirmed.
verify: Compare the activation date to the policy period boundaries.
Pass when the activation date falls within the policy period.

steps.title: Confirm retention and coverage basis are acceptable
sop: Read the deductible or retention amount from the certificate.
Confirm it is within the acceptable maximum and the basis is as required.
Done when retention and coverage basis are confirmed acceptable.
verify: Compare retention to the published acceptable maximum.
Pass when retention is at or below the maximum.

steps.title: Load the E&O expiry date into the producer record
sop: Enter the E&O expiry date on the producer record.
Confirm renewal monitoring picks up the loaded expiry date.
Done when the expiry date is loaded and visible to monitoring.
verify: Run the E&O expiry monitoring view and locate the producer.
Pass when the producer appears with the correct expiry date.

steps.title: File the certificate and record the validation outcome
sop: File the certificate in the compliance evidence repository.
Record the validation outcome and date on the producer record.
Done when the certificate is filed and the outcome is recorded.
verify: Check no producer is activated with expired or below-minimum cover.
Pass when activation only follows a passing validation outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every requested writing authority line against the licensed lines of authority per state.
generic.In-scope period: Licence lines active as at the authority configuration date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Requested line, licensed line code and match result are populated per state row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Configured authority lines equal the licensed lines of authority.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The PDB line extract is retained with its retrieval timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requested authority exceeding licence is logged with the restriction applied.
generic.Test population: Every requested line and state pair on the executed agreement exhibit.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if configured authority exceeds licensed authority in any state.
generic.Exception handling path: Excess requests are restricted and referred to the compliance manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Match is confirmed when configured authority equals licensed authority.
generic.Evidence location: Authority configuration in the agency/producer management system with the PDB extract.

steps.title: Extract requested writing authority from the agreement exhibit
sop: Read the requested writing authority by line from the executed exhibit.
Record the requested lines per state on the authority worksheet.
Done when requested authority is recorded per state and line.
verify: Compare recorded requests to the exhibit line entries.
Pass when the worksheet matches the exhibit.

steps.title: Extract licensed lines of authority from the PDB
sop: Query the PDB and list licensed lines of authority per state.
Capture the extract with its retrieval timestamp.
Done when licensed lines are listed per state from the PDB.
verify: Check the extract covers every state on the requested list.
Pass when no requested state is missing from the extract.

steps.title: Compare requested lines to licensed line codes
sop: Compare each requested line to the licensed line of authority code.
Mark each pair as match or mismatch on the worksheet.
Done when every requested line carries a match result.
verify: List requested lines without a match result.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Restrict authority where the request exceeds the licence
sop: Identify requests exceeding licence such as variable products without registration.
Restrict the authority setup to the licensed scope only.
Record the restriction and its reason on the producer record.
Done when every excess request is restricted and recorded.
verify: List excess requests without an applied restriction.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Apply the restricted authority configuration in the distribution system
sop: Configure the writing authority in the producer management system to the matched scope.
Confirm the portal reflects the configured authority for the producer.
Done when configured authority equals the matched licensed scope.
verify: Compare configured authority lines to the licensed lines per state.
Pass when configured authority never exceeds licensed authority.

steps.title: Record the line-of-authority match result
sop: Store the line-by-line match result on the producer record.
Attach the PDB extract used as the supporting evidence.
Done when the match result and extract are stored.
verify: Open the producer record and read the stored match result.
Pass when the result is present with the attached extract.

generic.Defined scope/population: The agency and each individual producer to be granted binding access.
generic.In-scope period: Licence status as at the verification query date before binding access is granted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: NPN, licence status, expiry date and PDB name and address are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: PDB responses returned equal the NPNs queried for binding access.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The PDB response is attached with its retrieval timestamp as evidence.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Name or address mismatches are logged and resolved before verification passes.
generic.Test population: The agency plus every individual scheduled for binding access.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if binding access is active for a producer whose PDB status is not Active.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-active statuses stop verification and route to the licence gap process.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Verified status requires an Active PDB licence for every state to be enabled.
generic.Evidence location: Producer record in the agency/producer management system with attached PDB responses.

steps.title: Query the NIPR PDB by NPN for the agency and individuals
sop: Query the PDB by NPN for the agency and each individual for binding access.
Capture each response with the retrieval timestamp.
Done when a PDB response exists for every queried NPN.
verify: Count responses against the NPNs queried.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Confirm Active status and future expiry for enabled states
sop: Read licence status and expiry for each state to be enabled.
Confirm status is Active and expiry is not in the past.
Done when every enabled state shows an Active unexpired licence.
verify: List enabled states with a non-Active or expired licence.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Reconcile PDB name and address to the producer master record
sop: Compare the PDB name and address to the producer master record.
Log and resolve any mismatch before verification is set.
Done when name and address reconcile or the mismatch is resolved.
verify: Re-read both records after any correction.
Pass when the PDB and master record agree.

steps.title: Capture the PDB response as verification evidence
sop: Attach the PDB response to the producer record.
Confirm the attachment shows the retrieval timestamp.
Done when the timestamped response is attached as evidence.
verify: Open the attachment and read the timestamp.
Pass when the timestamp is present and matches the query date.

steps.title: Set licence verification status to Verified
sop: Set the licence verification status to Verified on the producer record.
Record the verifying analyst and the verification date.
Done when Verified status, analyst and date are recorded.
verify: Confirm Verified status only where all statuses are Active.
Pass when Verified implies every enabled state is Active.

steps.title: Release the binding-access gate in the Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Release the binding-access gate only after verification passes.
Confirm the portal shows binding enabled for verified states only.
Done when binding access is released for verified states.
verify: Test binding availability in the portal for a non-verified state.
Pass when binding is unavailable for any non-verified state.

generic.Defined scope/population: The complete producer licensing and compliance record for the certification period.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period ending at the certification period-end date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Period-end date, reconciliation reference and exception owners are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Active appointment counts reconcile to the NIPR appointment inventory.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The signed certification is filed with signer name and signature date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every open exception carries an owner, remediation plan and target date.
generic.Test population: The full producer population in scope for the period certification.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the period is certified with an unreconciled appointment variance.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled variances block certification until investigated and explained.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Certification requires a closed record, clean reconciliation and owned exceptions.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository certification filed against the period.

steps.title: Confirm the period compliance record is closed for changes
sop: Confirm all period updates to the producer compliance record are applied.
Lock the record for the period so no further changes are made.
Done when the period record is confirmed updated and locked.
verify: Check the change history shows no updates after the lock timestamp.
Pass when no post-lock change exists.

steps.title: Reconcile appointment counts to the NIPR inventory
sop: Extract active appointment counts by state from the producer master.
Compare them against the NIPR appointment inventory for the period.
Record every variance with its explanation.
Done when all variances are recorded and explained.
verify: Recompute the variance total after explanations are applied.
Pass when no unexplained variance remains.

steps.title: Confirm every open exception has an owner and plan
sop: List open exceptions in the GRC platform for the period.
Confirm each carries an owner, remediation plan and target date.
Done when every open exception is fully owned and planned.
verify: List exceptions missing an owner, plan or target date.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Assemble the certification pack
sop: Assemble the reconciliation, exception list and record lock evidence.
Reference each item on the certification statement.
Done when the certification pack references all supporting evidence.
verify: Check each referenced item resolves to a filed document.
Pass when every reference resolves.

steps.title: Sign the period certification
sop: Sign the certification stating the record is complete and accurate at period end.
Record the signer name, role and signature date.
Done when the certification is signed and dated.
verify: Read the signature block on the certification.
Pass when signer, role and date are all present.

steps.title: File the certification in the compliance evidence repository
sop: File the signed certification against the period in the evidence repository.
Link the certification to the producer compliance record.
Done when the certification is filed and linked to the period.
verify: Retrieve the certification by period from the repository.
Pass when it returns with signer, date and reconciliation reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: All active producers as at the annual attestation cut-off date.
generic.In-scope period: The attestation year covered by the annual compliance attestation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attestation questions, response status and disclosure details are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Responses received plus non-responders equal the active-producer population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each response is retained with its submission timestamp and attestation version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every affirmative disclosure is logged as an exception with a review disposition.
generic.Test population: The full active-producer population at the cut-off date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the completion report does not reconcile to the full population.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-responders escalate at the defined intervals to the field manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The cycle closes with a completion report and a handed-over exception list.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository attestation cycle folder for the year.

steps.title: Generate the active-producer population at cut-off
sop: Extract the active-producer population from the producer master at the cut-off date.
Record the population count as the attestation control total.
Done when the population and control total are recorded.
verify: Recount the extract rows against the recorded control total.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Issue the annual attestation through the Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Issue the attestation covering licence currency, E&O, regulatory actions, AML training and conflicts.
Confirm each producer in the population receives the attestation.
Done when the attestation is issued to the full population.
verify: Count issued attestations against the population control total.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Track responses and chase non-responders
sop: Track responses received against the issued population.
Chase non-responders at the defined intervals and record each chase.
Done when every non-responder has a recorded chase history.
verify: List non-responders without a chase record.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Review affirmative disclosures and open exceptions
sop: Review each affirmative disclosure of regulatory action, E&O lapse or ownership change.
Open an exception item for every affirmative disclosure.
Record a review disposition for each exception raised.
Done when every affirmative disclosure has an exception and disposition.
verify: List affirmative disclosures without an exception item.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Produce the attestation completion report
sop: Produce the completion rate report reconciled to the population control total.
State responded, outstanding and disclosure counts in the report.
Done when the report reconciles to the population control total.
verify: Sum responded plus outstanding and compare to the population.
Pass when the sum equals the population count.

steps.title: Close the cycle and hand the exception list to remediation
sop: Hand the exception list to the remediation queue with owners assigned.
File the completion report in the compliance evidence repository.
Close the attestation cycle with the closure date recorded.
Done when the cycle is closed and the exception list is handed over.
verify: Check no disclosure exception is closed without a review disposition.
Pass when every closed exception carries a disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: All investigated producer compliance exceptions requiring documented disposition.
generic.In-scope period: Exceptions detected and investigated within the current monitoring period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Producer code, exception type, detection date and source are populated per record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documented exceptions equal the investigated exception count for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Supporting evidence is attached with its retrieval date on every exception.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each record states remediated, waived with approval, or escalated for termination.
generic.Test population: Every exception record closed in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a closed exception has no attached remediation evidence.
generic.Exception handling path: Waivers require a named approver before the record can be closed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closure requires root cause, disposition, approver and attached evidence.
generic.Evidence location: Exception records in the GRC platform linked to the producer record.

steps.title: Record exception identity and detection detail in the GRC platform
sop: Record producer code, exception type, detection date and detection source.
Link the exception to the producer record in the producer management system.
Done when identity and detection detail are recorded and linked.
verify: Open the link and confirm it resolves to the correct producer.
Pass when the link resolves correctly.

steps.title: Record the investigation conclusion and root cause
sop: Record the investigation conclusion in the exception record.
Select the root cause category from the controlled list.
Done when conclusion and root cause category are recorded.
verify: List exceptions with a free-text root cause instead of a category.
Pass when every exception uses a controlled category.

steps.title: Record the disposition and approver in Archer GRC
sop: Record the disposition as remediated, waived with approval or escalated.
Record the approver name for waived and escalated dispositions.
Done when disposition and approver are recorded.
verify: List waived dispositions with no named approver.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Attach the supporting evidence to the exception record
sop: Attach the PDB extract, screening result or correspondence supporting the conclusion.
Confirm each attachment carries a retrieval or receipt date.
Done when supporting evidence is attached and dated.
verify: Open each attachment and read its date.
Pass when every attachment carries a date.

steps.title: Set the exception status to Closed where evidenced
sop: Close only exceptions where remediation evidence is attached.
Leave exceptions open where evidence is outstanding.
Done when statuses reflect the presence of remediation evidence.
verify: List closed exceptions without attached remediation evidence.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Reconcile documented exceptions to the investigation queue
sop: Compare documented exception records to the investigated exception list.
Record any investigation without a documented exception record.
Done when documentation covers every investigated exception.
verify: Count documented records against investigated exceptions.
Pass when the counts agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: All producers identified for appointment termination as inactive or for cause.
generic.In-scope period: Terminations filed within each state notice deadline from the termination date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Termination classification, rationale, approver and effective date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: NIPR termination confirmations equal the affected state count per producer.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each termination confirmation number is stored with its submission date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected termination filings are logged with the error and resubmission date.
generic.Test population: Every state appointment held by the terminating producer.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a for-cause termination is filed past a state reporting deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed for-cause classifications route to compliance leadership before filing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Termination is complete when filings, access removal and commission treatment are done.
generic.Evidence location: Producer record in the agency/producer management system with NIPR confirmations.

steps.title: Classify the termination and record the rationale
sop: Classify the termination as for cause or not for cause.
Record the supporting rationale and the approving manager.
Done when classification, rationale and approver are recorded.
verify: Read the classification and approver on the producer record.
Pass when both are populated with a rationale.

steps.title: Determine state filing deadlines and reporting requirements
sop: List each affected state and its termination notice deadline.
Record the for-cause reporting requirement where it applies.
Done when every affected state carries a deadline and requirement.
verify: Spot-check three state deadlines against the published requirement.
Pass when the sampled deadlines are correct.

steps.title: Submit termination transactions through NIPR
sop: Submit the appointment termination transaction for each affected state.
Capture the confirmation number returned per state.
Resubmit any rejected transaction and record the resubmission.
Done when every affected state has a confirmation number.
verify: Count confirmations against affected states.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Terminate portal access and writing authority
sop: Disable portal access effective the termination date.
Revoke writing authority and stop new-business flow under the producer code.
Done when access and writing authority are both terminated.
verify: Test portal login and submission entry for the terminated producer.
Pass when both are unavailable.

steps.title: Set the commission run-off treatment in the billing platform
sop: Read the termination clause treatment from the executed agreement.
Set the run-off or vesting treatment on the producer record.
Done when the commission treatment is configured per the agreement.
verify: Compare the configured treatment to the agreement termination clause.
Pass when configuration matches the agreement.

steps.title: Confirm filing timeliness and close the termination
sop: Compare each filing date to the applicable state deadline.
Record any late filing with its cause and remediation.
Close the termination case with the confirmation evidence attached.
Done when timeliness is confirmed and the case is closed.
verify: List for-cause filings submitted past the state deadline.
Pass when that list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: The producer compliance exceptions assigned for investigation in the period.
generic.In-scope period: Triggering data as at the exception detection date through the investigation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Triggering data, source system, root cause category and conclusion are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Investigated exceptions equal the exceptions assigned in the queue.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Source system evidence is captured with retrieval timestamps per exception.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Data-defect findings are logged with a correction action on the source record.
generic.Test population: Every exception in the investigation queue for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a conclusion is reached without confirming the trigger at source.
generic.Exception handling path: Conduct-related findings escalate to compliance leadership before disposition.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Investigation closes with a root cause category and supporting evidence references.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform exception records with attached source system extracts.

steps.title: Pull the exception detail from the GRC platform
sop: Open the exception record and read the triggering condition.
Note the detection source and detection date.
Done when the triggering condition and source are noted.
verify: Compare the noted trigger to the exception record fields.
Pass when the notes match the record.

steps.title: Confirm the triggering data at source in NIPR or the producer master
sop: Re-query the source system for the licence status, screening hit or attestation response.
Capture the source response with its retrieval timestamp.
Done when the trigger is confirmed or refuted at source.
verify: Check the source extract is attached with a timestamp.
Pass when the attached extract is timestamped.

steps.title: Determine whether the exception is a breach or a data mismatch
sop: Compare the PDB value against the producer master value.
Classify the exception as a genuine breach or a data-quality mismatch.
Done when the breach or mismatch classification is recorded.
verify: Re-read both system values supporting the classification.
Pass when the classification follows from the compared values.

steps.title: Interview the field manager and producer where conduct is involved
sop: Contact the assigned field manager for context on the producer activity.
Contact the producer where the exception concerns conduct.
Record each interview with date and substance.
Done when required interviews are held and recorded.
verify: List conduct exceptions with no interview record.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Determine the root cause category
sop: Assign the root cause as producer failure, carrier process failure or data defect.
State the evidence supporting the assignment.
Done when the root cause category and evidence are stated.
verify: Check the stated evidence supports the assigned category.
Pass when the evidence and category are consistent.

steps.title: Record the conclusion and route to disposition
sop: Record the investigation conclusion with evidence references.
Route the exception to the documentation and disposition task.
Done when the conclusion is recorded and routed.
verify: List conclusions without a source confirmation reference.
Pass when that list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: The suspended producer contacts and the assigned field manager to be notified.
generic.In-scope period: Notification issued within the SLA window from the suspension effective time.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Suspension scope, effective time, remediation requirement and evidence needed are stated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: States and lines in the notice equal the suspended scope on the producer record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The notification is attached to the suspension case with a send timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undeliverable notices are logged and reissued to a verified contact.
generic.Test population: All suspension notifications issued for the producer.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a suspension passes the SLA window without notification.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing contact details escalate to the field manager for immediate resolution.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notification is complete when scope, remediation and in-flight treatment are all stated.
generic.Evidence location: Suspension case in the workflow tool with the attached notification.

steps.title: Identify producer contacts and the assigned field manager
sop: Read the producer principal contacts from the producer master.
Identify the assigned field manager from the territory assignment.
Done when producer contacts and field manager are identified.
verify: Cross-check the contacts against the current producer record.
Pass when contacts and manager are current on the record.

steps.title: State the exact suspension scope in the notification
sop: State the suspended states, lines and the effective date and time.
Confirm the stated scope matches the applied suspension.
Done when the notification states the exact suspension scope.
verify: Compare stated scope to the suspension record on the producer master.
Pass when the two scopes match exactly.

steps.title: State the remediation required and evidence needed
sop: State the specific remediation action required to lift the suspension.
State the evidence the producer must supply and to whom.
Done when remediation and required evidence are stated.
verify: Check the remediation statement is specific rather than generic.
Pass when the statement names a concrete action and evidence.

steps.title: State the treatment of in-flight submissions and renewals
sop: State how in-flight submissions will be handled during the suspension.
State how existing renewals will be serviced.
Done when in-flight and renewal treatment are both stated.
verify: Compare the stated treatment to the suspension policy.
Pass when the treatment matches the policy.

steps.title: Send the notification via Microsoft Teams or email
sop: Send the notification to the producer contacts and the field manager.
Capture the send timestamp and recipient list.
Done when the notification is sent and the timestamp captured.
verify: Check the send timestamp against the suspension effective time.
Pass when the notice is sent within the SLA window.

steps.title: Attach the notification to the suspension case
sop: Attach the sent notification to the suspension case in the workflow tool.
