Link the case to the producer record in the producer management system.
Done when the notification is attached and the case linked.
verify: Open the suspension case and read the attached notification.
Pass when the attachment shows scope and remediation with a timestamp.

generic.Defined scope/population: All pending and renewing state appointments requiring fee payment in the period.
generic.In-scope period: The current fee payment period ending at the state renewal deadlines.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State, transaction type, fee rate and payment reference are populated per row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The NIPR settlement statement reconciles to the fee schedule and the ledger.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Payment confirmation and per-state receipts are retained with payment date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Underfunded or failed payments are logged with the corrective action taken.
generic.Test population: Every appointment fee transaction in the period batch.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an appointment lapses through non-payment within the period.
generic.Exception handling path: Funding shortfalls escalate before the batch is released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Payment is accepted when receipts reconcile to the schedule and the ledger.
generic.Evidence location: NIPR payment confirmations filed with the billing and commission platform records.

steps.title: Build the state appointment fee schedule for the period
sop: List pending and renewing appointments requiring fees in the period.
Build the fee schedule with state, transaction type and fee amount.
Done when the fee schedule covers every fee-bearing transaction.
verify: Count schedule rows against the pending and renewing appointment list.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Reconcile fee amounts to the published NIPR rates
sop: Compare each fee amount to the current published NIPR or state rate.
Correct any row using a superseded rate.
Done when every fee row uses a current published rate.
verify: Spot-check five rows against the published rate table.
Pass when the sampled rows use current rates.

steps.title: Confirm NIPR funding account balance covers the batch
sop: Read the NIPR funding account balance before release.
Compare it to the total fee schedule amount.
Request a top-up if the balance is short.
Done when the balance covers the batch total.
verify: Recompare balance to batch total immediately before release.
Pass when the balance meets or exceeds the total.

steps.title: Release the fee payment through NIPR
sop: Release the fee payment batch through NIPR.
Capture the payment confirmation and each per-state receipt.
Done when the payment confirmation and receipts are captured.
verify: Count per-state receipts against the fee schedule rows.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Reconcile the NIPR settlement to the general ledger
sop: Compare the NIPR settlement statement to the appointment-fee ledger account.
Investigate and record every variance found.
Done when the settlement reconciles or variances are explained.
verify: Recompute the reconciliation difference after explanations.
Pass when no unexplained difference remains.

steps.title: Confirm no appointment lapsed for non-payment
sop: Check appointment statuses for the states in the fee batch.
Investigate any appointment showing lapsed after payment.
Record the confirmation on the period fee record.
Done when no appointment in the batch is lapsed for non-payment.
verify: Query appointment status for every state in the batch.
Pass when no state shows a lapse due to non-payment.

generic.Defined scope/population: All appointments falling due for renewal in the upcoming renewal cycle by state.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal cycle window ending at each state renewal deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State, expiry date, producer status and renewal decision are populated per row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Renewed plus intentionally non-renewed equals the pre-renewal population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: NIPR renewal confirmations are stored with their submission dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Non-renewal decisions are logged with rationale and routed to termination.
generic.Test population: The full appointment renewal population for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an appointment lapses for a producer still writing business.
generic.Exception handling path: Variances at reconciliation are investigated before the cycle closes.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every renewal row ends with a confirmation or a documented non-renewal decision.
generic.Evidence location: Producer records and renewal cases in the workflow case management tool.

steps.title: Generate the renewal population by state
sop: Extract appointments expiring in the upcoming cycle with expiry dates by state.
Record the population count as the renewal control total.
Done when the renewal population and control total are recorded.
verify: Recount the extract rows against the control total.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Confirm producer standing and licensing for each renewal
sop: Check each producer is active, in good standing and licensed in that state.
Flag any producer failing a standing or licensing check.
Done when every renewal row carries a standing check result.
verify: List renewal rows without a standing check result.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Identify intentional non-renewals and route to termination
sop: Identify producers intended for non-renewal with rationale.
Route each non-renewal to the appointment termination process.
Done when every non-renewal is identified and routed.
verify: Check each non-renewal has a termination case raised.
Pass when every non-renewal is routed to termination.

steps.title: Submit renewal transactions through NIPR ahead of deadline
sop: Submit renewal transactions for every renewing state before the deadline.
Capture the NIPR confirmation for each transaction.
Rework and resubmit any rejected transaction.
Done when every renewing state has a confirmation.
verify: Compare submission dates to the state renewal deadlines.
Pass when all submissions precede their deadlines.

steps.title: Reconcile the renewed inventory to the pre-renewal population
sop: Compare the renewed appointment inventory to the pre-renewal population.
Investigate every variance and record its explanation.
Done when all variances are investigated and explained.
verify: Sum renewed plus non-renewed and compare to the population.
Pass when the sum equals the pre-renewal population.

steps.title: Confirm no writing producer lapsed through missed renewal
sop: Cross-check lapsed appointments against producers still writing business.
Raise an urgent remediation case for any such lapse.
Record the cycle closure with the confirmation result.
Done when the cycle closes with the lapse check recorded.
verify: List lapsed appointments for producers still submitting business.
Pass when that list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: All producers monitored and all exceptions raised or closed in the reporting period.
generic.In-scope period: The monitoring period covered by the summary with a stated extract date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Counts, appointment movements, screening outcomes and trends are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Headline counts reconcile to the dated producer master extract.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The summary states the extract date and the report version issued.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Figures that cannot be traced to a source extract are removed and logged.
generic.Test population: Every headline figure published in the monitoring summary.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any published figure cannot be traced to a dated source extract.
generic.Exception handling path: Untraceable figures are withheld pending reconciliation before distribution.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The summary is issued only when every headline reconciles to the extract.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI monitoring report with the producer master extract retained alongside.

steps.title: Compile period exception counts from the producer management system
sop: Compile producers monitored, exceptions raised, exceptions closed and aged over SLA.
Record the extract date used for each count.
Done when all four counts are compiled with an extract date.
verify: Recount exceptions raised against the exception register.
Pass when report counts equal register counts.

steps.title: Report appointment inventory movement by state
sop: Report new appointments, renewals, terminations and lapses by state.
Confirm opening plus movement equals closing inventory.
Done when the movement report balances to closing inventory.
verify: Recompute opening plus movements against closing inventory.
Pass when the computation balances.

steps.title: Report screening outcomes and dispositions
sop: Report screening runs, true hits and the disposition of each hit.
Confirm every reported true hit has a recorded disposition.
Done when screening outcomes and dispositions are reported.
verify: List reported true hits without a disposition.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Trend exception volume and resolution time in Power BI
sop: Trend exception volume against the prior three periods.
Trend mean time to resolve over the same periods.
Done when both trends cover four periods including the current one.
verify: Check the trend series contains four consecutive periods.
Pass when four consecutive periods are present.

steps.title: Reconcile headline figures to the producer master extract
sop: Trace each headline figure to the dated producer master extract.
Remove or correct any figure that cannot be traced.
Note the extract date on the summary.
Done when every headline traces to the dated extract.
verify: List headline figures without a traced source.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Review and release the monitoring summary
sop: Review the summary content, trends and reconciliation notes.
Confirm the extract date is stated on the published report.
Approve release and record the approval on the report record.
Done when the summary is approved and released with an extract date.
verify: Read the published summary for the stated extract date.
Pass when the extract date is present and the approval is recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: The daily NIPR PDB alert file and the producer master and appointment inventory.
generic.In-scope period: The current processing day for the loaded PDB alert file.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: NPN, alert type, alert date and match status are populated per alert row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Loaded record count equals the file control total.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The load log is retained with the file name, control total and load timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unmatched alerts are routed to manual research with an owner and outcome.
generic.Test population: Every alert row in the daily file, not a sample.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any unmatched alert remains unresearched at end of day.
generic.Exception handling path: Status-degrading alerts raise exception items routed to the licence queue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The day is complete when the load balances and every degrading alert has an item.
generic.Evidence location: Load logs in the enterprise data warehouse and exception items on producer records.

steps.title: Load the daily NIPR PDB alert file into the data warehouse
sop: Load the daily alert file into the warehouse staging area.
Compare the loaded record count to the file control total.
Done when the load completes with a matching control total.
verify: Read the load log record count and the file control total.
Pass when the two figures match.

steps.title: Match alerts to producer master records by NPN
sop: Match each alert to a producer master record on NPN.
Route unmatched alerts to the manual research queue with an owner.
Done when every alert is matched or routed to research.
verify: Count matched plus routed alerts against the loaded count.
Pass when the sum equals the loaded record count.

steps.title: Classify each alert by type
sop: Classify each alert as expiry, lapse, cancellation, suspension, address or line change.
Record the classification on the alert row.
Done when every alert carries a classification.
verify: List alerts with no classification recorded.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Reconcile the appointment inventory against the alerts
sop: Identify appointments now unsupported by an active licence.
List each unsupported appointment with its state and producer code.
Done when unsupported appointments are identified and listed.
verify: Recheck each listed appointment against the current licence status.
Pass when every listed appointment is genuinely unsupported.

steps.title: Raise exception items for status-degrading alerts
sop: Raise an exception item for every status-degrading alert.
Assign an owner and due date to each exception raised.
Done when every degrading alert has an owned exception item.
verify: Count exception items against degrading alerts.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Confirm zero unprocessed records at end of day
sop: Review the load and research queues at end of day.
Confirm no alert remains unprocessed or unresearched.
Record the daily completion status on the load log.
Done when the daily completion status is recorded.
verify: Query the queues for records still open at end of day.
Pass when both queues return zero open records.

generic.Defined scope/population: Suspended producers whose remediation evidence has been received for reinstatement.
generic.In-scope period: From remediation evidence receipt to the reinstatement effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Verifying source, approver, clearance reason and reinstatement date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Restored states and lines equal the scope held before suspension.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The verifying source extract is retained with its retrieval timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Partial remediations are logged with the restricted scope reinstated.
generic.Test population: All reinstatement requests processed for the producer.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if reinstated authority exceeds the pre-suspension scope.
generic.Exception handling path: Unverifiable evidence keeps the hold in place pending source confirmation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reinstatement requires verified source evidence and a named approver.
generic.Evidence location: Exception record in the compliance evidence repository with the producer record link.

steps.title: Confirm the remediation evidence at source
sop: Re-query the PDB, screening system or E&O certificate as applicable.
Confirm the underlying status now satisfies the requirement.
Done when the source confirms the remediated status.
verify: Check the source extract is attached with a retrieval timestamp.
Pass when the extract is attached and timestamped.

steps.title: Obtain the reinstatement approval
sop: Present the verified evidence to the accountable compliance manager.
Record the approver name and approval date on the exception record.
Done when the reinstatement approval is recorded.
verify: Read the approver and approval date on the exception record.
Pass when both are populated.

steps.title: Clear the hold flag on the producer master
sop: Clear the hold flag on the producer master record.
Record the clearance reason and the clearance timestamp.
Done when the hold flag is cleared with a recorded reason.
verify: Query the producer record for remaining hold flags.
Pass when no hold flag remains for the remediated issue.

steps.title: Restore portal access to the pre-suspension scope
sop: Restore portal access to the previously approved states and lines only.
Confirm no additional state or line is enabled during restoration.
Done when access equals the pre-suspension scope.
verify: Compare the restored scope to the pre-suspension scope record.
Pass when restored scope does not exceed the prior scope.

steps.title: Notify the producer and field manager of reinstatement
sop: Notify the producer and the assigned field manager of the reinstatement.
State the effective date and the restored scope in the notice.
Done when both parties are notified with scope and date.
verify: Read the notification log entries on the exception record.
Pass when both notifications appear with timestamps.

steps.title: File the reinstatement evidence pack
sop: File the source evidence, approval and notifications as one pack.
Attach the pack to the exception record in the evidence repository.
Done when the reinstatement evidence pack is filed.
verify: Retrieve the pack and check it names the source, approver and date.
Pass when all three appear in the filed pack.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open licence expiration and lapse exceptions in the resolution queue.
generic.In-scope period: From exception detection date to closure within the agreed SLA window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Due date, current PDB status, contact record and resolution type are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exceptions closed plus exceptions open equals the exceptions detected.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Closure evidence is attached with the PDB retrieval timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: SLA breaches are logged with an escalation and the reason for delay.
generic.Test population: Every licence exception in the queue for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any exception exceeds SLA with no logged escalation.
generic.Exception handling path: Approaching breaches escalate to the compliance manager before the threshold.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closure requires a resolution type and supporting evidence on every exception.
generic.Evidence location: Exception cases in the workflow tool linked to the producer records.

steps.title: Work the exception queue in due-date order
sop: Sort the licence exception queue by due date ascending.
Work exceptions in that order and record the working date on each.
Done when the queue is worked in due-date order for the day.
verify: Check the worked sequence against the due-date order.
Pass when no later-dated exception is worked ahead of an earlier one.

steps.title: Confirm the current PDB status for each exception
sop: Re-query the PDB for the producer licence status.
Record whether the producer has renewed since detection.
Done when each exception carries a current PDB status.
verify: Check every exception has a PDB status dated after detection.
Pass when all statuses postdate the detection date.

steps.title: Contact producers whose licence remains lapsed
sop: Contact the producer with the specific renewal requirement and deadline.
Record the contact date and the producer commitment given.
Done when every lapsed producer has a recorded contact.
verify: List lapsed exceptions without a producer contact record.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Escalate exceptions approaching the SLA threshold
sop: Identify exceptions approaching the SLA breach threshold.
Escalate each with the reason for delay recorded.
Done when every approaching breach carries an escalation.
verify: List exceptions past SLA without an escalation record.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Close each exception with resolution type and evidence
sop: Record the resolution type on each resolved exception.
Attach the PDB extract or correspondence as closure evidence.
Done when every closed exception carries type and evidence.
verify: List closed exceptions without attached evidence.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Report the period SLA-breach count
sop: Count exceptions closed inside and outside SLA for the period.
Record the breach count and the top delay reasons.
Done when the SLA-breach count and reasons are recorded.
verify: Recount breaches from the exception case data.
Pass when the reported and recounted figures agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full active producer and appointment population, not a sample.
generic.In-scope period: Licence expiry compared against the sweep run date across 90, 60, 30 and 0 day buckets.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Licence expiry, licence status and authority configuration are populated per record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sweep population count equals the active producer count at run date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The run record retains run date, population count and exception count.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every 30-day-or-less and lapsed record raises an owned exception item.
generic.Test population: All active producers and their appointments at the run date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any active producer is excluded from the sweep population.
generic.Exception handling path: Records failing the sweep route to the licence exception resolution queue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The sweep is complete when the run record and all exceptions exist.
generic.Evidence location: Sweep run record in the enterprise data warehouse with exception items on producer records.

steps.title: Build the sweep population from the producer master
sop: Extract the full active producer and appointment population at the run date.
Record the population count as the sweep control total.
Done when the population and control total are recorded.
verify: Compare the population count to the active producer count.
Pass when the counts agree with no exclusions.

steps.title: Compare licence expiry dates to the run date
sop: Compare each licence expiry date against the sweep run date.
Bucket each record at 90, 60, 30 or 0 days to expiry.
Done when every record is bucketed.
verify: Sum the bucket counts and compare to the population count.
Pass when the bucket sum equals the population.

steps.title: Identify lapsed and cancelled licences from NIPR data
sop: Identify licences already lapsed or cancelled at the run date.
Identify licences whose lines no longer support configured authority.
Done when lapsed and unsupported-authority records are identified.
verify: Spot-check five identified records against the PDB status.
Pass when the sampled records match the PDB status.

steps.title: Generate exception items and assign owners
sop: Generate an exception item for every 30-day-or-less and lapsed record.
Assign an owner and a due date to each exception.
Done when every qualifying record has an owned exception.
verify: Count exception items against qualifying records.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Record the sweep run evidence
sop: Record the sweep run date, population count and exception count.
File the run record in the data warehouse run log.
Done when the run evidence is recorded and filed.
verify: Read the run record for date, population and exception counts.
Pass when all three values are present.

steps.title: Confirm no active producer was excluded
sop: Reconcile the sweep population to the active producer master list.
Investigate and record any producer absent from the sweep.
Done when every active producer is accounted for in the sweep.
verify: List active producers absent from the sweep population.
Pass when that list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full active producer population including principals submitted to scheduled screening.
generic.In-scope period: Screening run against list versions published at the scheduled run date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Names, identifiers and screening submission status are populated per record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Names screened equal the active producer and principal population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The run certificate records population count, list version and hit count.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each potential match is adjudicated with analyst name, rationale and date.
generic.Test population: The full active producer population, not a sample.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a true sanctions match has no immediate suspension action.
generic.Exception handling path: True hits trigger suspension and notification of compliance leadership.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The run is accepted when the certificate and all adjudications are filed.
generic.Evidence location: Screening run certificate in the compliance evidence repository.

steps.title: Extract the active producer population for screening
sop: Extract the active producer population including principals from the producer master.
Record the population count as the screening control total.
Done when the population and control total are recorded.
verify: Compare the extract count to the active producer master count.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Submit the population to the sanctions screening system
sop: Load the population into the LexisNexis Bridger or FircoSoft system.
Run the screen and capture the response with the run timestamp.
Done when the screening run completes for the full population.
verify: Compare names returned to names submitted.
Pass when returned names equal submitted names.

steps.title: Confirm list versions are the latest published
sop: Read the OFAC and state watchlist versions loaded in the system.
Compare them to the latest published versions at the run date.
Done when list versions are confirmed current.
verify: Compare list publication dates to the run date.
Pass when the loaded lists are the latest published.

steps.title: Adjudicate potential matches in LexisNexis Risk
sop: Review each potential match against identifying data on the producer record.
Record true hit or false positive with analyst name, rationale and date.

Done when the completeness review is recorded.
verify: List cohort producers excluded with no logged reason.
Pass when that list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: All barriers preventing the new producer from submitting and quoting business.
generic.In-scope period: Portal and policy system activity since the producer activation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Barrier category, owner and target resolution date are populated per item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Logged barriers equal the defects and obstacles identified in the review.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Portal activity extracts are retained with their extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Producer-reported obstacles are logged verbatim with a disposition.
generic.Test population: Portal logs, entitlement records and the producer verbatim responses.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an open portal access or entitlement defect is unlogged.
generic.Exception handling path: System defects route to the workflow tool for technical resolution.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Identification is complete when every barrier has category, owner and date.
generic.Evidence location: Barrier items in the workflow tool linked to the CRM producer record.

steps.title: Review the producer portal activity log
sop: Review failed logins, abandoned quotes and incomplete submissions.
Record the counts and the dates of each pattern observed.
Done when the portal activity review is recorded.
verify: Check the review cites the extract date of the activity log.
Pass when the extract date is cited.

steps.title: Check for open access and entitlement issues
sop: Check for locked accounts and missing state or product entitlements.
Record each access defect found with its affected user.
Done when access and entitlement checks are complete.
verify: List access defects found but not logged as barrier items.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Check rating and quoting failures in the policy system
sop: Check logged rating and quoting failures under the producer code.
Record each failure with its error and frequency.
Done when rating and quoting failures are recorded.
verify: Compare recorded failures to the policy system error log.
Pass when the records match the error log.

steps.title: Ask the producer for the top three obstacles
sop: Ask the producer directly for their top three obstacles.
Record the verbatim response in the CRM producer record.
Done when the verbatim producer response is recorded.
verify: Read the recorded response for three named obstacles.
Pass when three obstacles are recorded.

steps.title: Log each barrier with category, owner and target date
sop: Log each identified barrier in the workflow tool.
Assign a category, an owner and a target resolution date.
Done when every barrier is logged with all three fields.
verify: List barrier items missing category, owner or target date.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Confirm no identified defect is left unlogged
sop: Compare the identified defect list to the logged barrier items.
Log any defect not yet represented as a barrier item.
Done when every identified defect has a barrier item.
verify: Count logged barriers against identified defects and obstacles.
Pass when the counts agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: Coaching or training interventions targeted at the producer logged barriers.
generic.In-scope period: From barrier logging to the re-measurement date after the intervention.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Barrier link, intervention type, date, attendees and follow-up are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Interventions delivered equal the barriers requiring an intervention.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The intervention record stores its date, attendees and materials version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Barriers needing no intervention are logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: Every logged barrier assigned an intervention.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a barrier is closed with no evidence the intervention was delivered.
generic.Exception handling path: Repeat barriers after intervention escalate to the remediation task.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Intervention is complete when linked to a barrier with a re-measurement date.
generic.Evidence location: Producer record intervention note in CRM with the LMS delivery record.

steps.title: Select the intervention matched to the logged barrier
sop: Read the logged barrier category and its detail.
Select the coaching or training intervention that addresses that barrier.
Done when a barrier-matched intervention is selected.
verify: Check the selected intervention addresses the logged barrier category.
Pass when intervention and barrier categories align.

steps.title: Schedule and deliver the intervention to affected individuals
sop: Schedule the intervention with the specific individuals affected.
Deliver the intervention and record attendance.
Done when the intervention is delivered and attendance recorded.
verify: Compare attendees to the individuals affected by the barrier.
Pass when all affected individuals attended.

steps.title: Work two live submissions where quality is the barrier
sop: Where the barrier is submission quality work two live submissions end to end.
Record the submission references worked in session.
Done when two live submissions are worked and referenced.
verify: Check the recorded submission references exist in the portal.
Pass when both references resolve to real submissions.

steps.title: Record the intervention on the producer record
sop: Record the intervention type, date and attendees in CRM.
Record the agreed follow-up with an owner.
Done when type, date, attendees and follow-up are recorded.
verify: Open the CRM record and read the intervention entry.
Pass when all four fields are present.

steps.title: Set the barrier re-measurement date
sop: Set a re-measurement date for the barrier metric after the intervention.
Link the re-measurement to the barrier item in the workflow tool.
Done when the re-measurement date is set and linked.
verify: List delivered interventions without a re-measurement date.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Confirm delivery evidence before closing the barrier
sop: Confirm the intervention delivery evidence is attached to the barrier item.
Close the barrier only where delivery evidence exists.
Done when barrier closures all carry delivery evidence.
verify: List closed barriers without intervention delivery evidence.
Pass when that list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: The new producer first submissions reviewed for data and appetite quality.
generic.In-scope period: Submissions entered from activation through the review date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Defect category, count and feedback action are populated per review.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Submissions reviewed equal the producer first submissions in the window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The review record stores its date and the submission references reviewed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Defects with no feedback action are logged and assigned before closure.
generic.Test population: All first submissions from the producer in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a defect category is recorded with no corresponding feedback action.
generic.Exception handling path: Repeated defect categories route to targeted coaching.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The review is complete when defects by category and feedback are recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Producer file review record in CRM with the PolicyCenter submission references.

steps.title: Pull the producer first submissions from the portal
sop: Pull every first submission entered by the producer in the window.
Record the submission references and the review data date.
Done when the submission set and data date are recorded.
verify: Compare the pulled count to the policy system submission count.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Review each submission for data completeness
sop: Review each submission against the published submission requirements.
Record any missing mandatory data field per submission.
Done when every submission has a completeness result.
verify: List submissions without a completeness result.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Check appetite fit, classification and exposure adequacy
sop: Check appetite fit and the correctness of the class code applied.
Check the exposure information supplied is adequate to rate.
Done when appetite, class and exposure checks are recorded.
verify: Compare class codes used to the correct classification.
Pass when misclassifications are all recorded as defects.

steps.title: Check required supporting documents were attached
sop: Check loss runs, schedules and applications were attached where required.
Record each missing document as a defect.
Done when document attachment checks are complete.
verify: List required documents missing but not recorded as defects.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Categorise and count defects by type
sop: Categorise each defect as missing data, wrong class, out of appetite or missing document.
Count defects by category across the reviewed submissions.
Done when defects are categorised and counted.
verify: Sum the category counts against total defects recorded.
Pass when the sums agree.

steps.title: Deliver feedback and record the review outcome
sop: Deliver the submission-quality feedback to the producer.
Record the review outcome and feedback action on the producer file.
Done when feedback is delivered and the outcome recorded.
verify: List defect categories with no corresponding feedback action.
Pass when that list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: The structured check-in cadence covering the producer first 90 days of production.
generic.In-scope period: From activation to day 90 with weekly then fortnightly check-ins.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each check-in carries a date, attendees, agenda and meeting owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scheduled check-ins equal the standard cadence meeting count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The schedule is recorded on the producer record as onboarding milestones.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declined slots are logged and rebooked inside the cadence window.
generic.Test population: Every check-in in the first-90-day cadence.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the schedule is incomplete or lacks a named meeting owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Cadence lapses escalate to the Agency Relations Manager for rebooking.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The cadence is accepted when dates are confirmed and owned end to end.
generic.Evidence location: CRM meeting series linked to the producer onboarding milestone list.

steps.title: Apply the standard first-90-day cadence
sop: Apply weekly check-ins to day 30 and fortnightly to day 90.
Calculate each check-in date from the activation date.
Done when every cadence date is calculated.
verify: Count calculated dates against the standard cadence count.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Book each check-in with the principal and field manager
sop: Issue invitations for every check-in in the cadence.
Confirm acceptance from the principal and field manager.
Done when every check-in is booked and accepted.
verify: List check-ins without an accepted invitation.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Attach the standard check-in agenda
sop: Attach the agenda covering pipeline, system issues, appetite and training.
Confirm the agenda is attached to every meeting in the series.
Done when every meeting carries the standard agenda.
verify: Open three meetings and read the attached agenda.
Pass when the agenda covers all four topics.

steps.title: Assign the meeting owner and set recurring reminders
sop: Assign a named meeting owner for the cadence.
Set the recurring reminder so the cadence does not lapse.
Done when the owner and recurring reminder are set.
verify: Read the meeting owner and reminder configuration.
Pass when both are set on the meeting series.

steps.title: Record the schedule as onboarding milestones
sop: Record every check-in date on the producer record as a milestone.
Link each milestone to its CRM meeting record.
Done when the full schedule is recorded as milestones.
verify: Count milestones against the cadence meeting count.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Confirm the cadence is complete and owned
sop: Review the schedule for gaps across the first 90 days.
Rebook any gap and confirm the owner for the full series.
Done when the cadence is gap-free and owned.
verify: Check the schedule covers activation to day 90 with no gap.
Pass when the coverage is continuous with a named owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: The new producer ramp metrics measured against the 30, 60 and 90-day targets.
generic.In-scope period: Production activity from activation to the stated data-as-at date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submissions, quote rate, bind rate, time-to-first-bind and premium are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported premium equals the policy system book of business for the code.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The scorecard states its data-as-at date and metric definition version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Metric anomalies are logged with the investigation outcome.
generic.Test population: All producer transactions under the producer code in the window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if reported premium differs from the policy system book of business.
generic.Exception handling path: Variances beyond tolerance route to the underperformance flagging task.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The scorecard is accepted when all five metrics show against target with a date.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI producer ramp scorecard sourced from Guidewire PolicyCenter.

steps.title: Extract producer transaction counts from PolicyCenter
sop: Extract submission, quote and bind counts plus written premium.
Record the extract data-as-at date.
Done when the counts and premium are extracted and dated.
verify: Compare the extract counts to the policy system totals.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Calculate quote rate, bind rate and time-to-first-bind
sop: Calculate quote rate and bind rate using the agreed metric definitions.
Calculate time-to-first-bind from the activation date.
Done when all three derived metrics are calculated.
verify: Recompute one derived metric independently.
Pass when the recomputed value matches the reported value.

steps.title: Compare each metric against the ramp target
sop: Compare each metric to the 30, 60 or 90-day ramp target.
Calculate and record the variance for each metric.
Done when every metric carries a variance against target.
verify: List metrics without a target comparison.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Reconcile written premium to the book of business
sop: Compare reported written premium to the policy system book of business.
Investigate and record any difference found.
Done when premium reconciles or the difference is explained.
verify: Recheck the book of business figure for the producer code.
Pass when the reported and system premium agree.

steps.title: Publish the scorecard on the agreed cadence
sop: Publish the ramp scorecard on the agreed reporting cadence.
State the data-as-at date on the published scorecard.
Done when the scorecard is published with its data date.
verify: Open the published scorecard and read the data-as-at date.
Pass when the date is present on the scorecard.

steps.title: Review the scorecard with the relationship team
sop: Review the metrics and variances with the relationship team.
Route significant shortfalls to the flagging task.
Record the review on the producer record.
Done when the review and any routing are recorded.
verify: Check the scorecard shows all five metrics against target.
Pass when all five metrics appear with targets and a data date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The producer being handed from onboarding oversight to steady-state management.
generic.In-scope period: From the 90-day milestone to the recorded transition date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exit criteria results, receiving manager and acceptance are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open actions handed over equal the open actions on the onboarding plan.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The transition record stores the transition date and accepting manager.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any unmet exit criterion is logged with a waiver or a remediation plan.
generic.Test population: All exit criteria and open items for the producer.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if transition occurs with an open compliance exception or barrier.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmet criteria block transition until closed or formally waived.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Transition requires exit criteria met and receiving manager acceptance.
generic.Evidence location: Producer master transition record with the closed onboarding plan case.

steps.title: Confirm the 90-day exit criteria are met
sop: Check the 90-day milestones are complete and training is current.
Check no open barrier remains on the producer record.
Done when all exit criteria results are recorded.
verify: List exit criteria not met and not waived.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Confirm licence, appointment and E&O statuses are current
sop: Check licence, appointment and E&O statuses on the producer record.
Confirm no open compliance exception exists.
Done when all three statuses are current with no open exception.
verify: Query open compliance exceptions for the producer.
Pass when the query returns zero open exceptions.

steps.title: Assign the steady-state channel manager
sop: Assign the steady-state channel manager for the producer.
Record the assignment on the producer master.
Done when the channel manager assignment is recorded.
verify: Read the assigned channel manager on the producer master.
Pass when the assignment is populated.

steps.title: Hand over the producer profile and open actions
sop: Hand over the producer profile, ramp history and relationship notes.
Hand over every open action with its owner and due date.
Done when the profile and all open actions are handed over.
verify: Count handed-over actions against open actions on the plan.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Confirm receiving manager acceptance
sop: Obtain the receiving manager acceptance of the handover.
Record the acceptance and its date on the producer record.
Done when acceptance and date are recorded.
verify: Read the acceptance entry on the producer record.
Pass when acceptance and date are populated.

steps.title: Close the onboarding plan with a transition date
sop: Close the onboarding plan case in the workflow tool.
Record the transition date on the producer master.
Done when the plan is closed and the transition date recorded.
verify: Check no producer is transitioned with an open exception or barrier.
Pass when the transition record shows a clean exit position.

generic.Defined scope/population: Flagged underperforming producers requiring remediation or escalation action.
generic.In-scope period: From the underperformance flag date to the recorded closure outcome.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Action type, owner, review date and closure outcome are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Actions triggered equal the current underperformance flags.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The remediation plan stores its creation date and agreed weekly targets.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Flags closed without action are logged with the justification.
generic.Test population: Every current underperformance flag in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a flag stays open past its review date with no recorded action.
generic.Exception handling path: Exit recommendations route to the leadership escalation task.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Action is complete when the plan closes as recovered, extended or escalated.
generic.Evidence location: Remediation cases in the workflow tool linked to the CRM producer record.

steps.title: Confirm the underperformance flag is still current
sop: Re-read the flag and the current ramp metrics.
Confirm the shortfall persists after the previous intervention.
Done when the persistence of the shortfall is confirmed.
verify: Compare the current metric to the metric at flagging.
Pass when the shortfall is confirmed to persist.

steps.title: Select the action from the escalation matrix
sop: Read the escalation matrix for the shortfall severity and duration.
Select remediation plan, authority restriction or escalation for exit.
Done when the matrix-driven action is selected.
verify: Check the selected action matches the matrix requirement.
Pass when the selection matches the matrix.

steps.title: Create the remediation plan with weekly targets
sop: Create the plan with specific weekly targets in the workflow tool.
State the support committed and the defined review date.
Done when the plan carries weekly targets, support and a review date.
verify: Read the plan for weekly targets and a review date.
Pass when both are present.

steps.title: Record the action and notify the agency principal
sop: Record the action, owner and review date on the CRM producer record.
Notify the agency principal of the action in writing.
Done when the action is recorded and the principal notified.
verify: Read the notification log on the producer record.
Pass when a written notification is logged.

steps.title: Track the remediation plan to its review date
sop: Track the weekly targets against actual production.
Escalate before the review date where targets are missed again.
Done when the plan is tracked to its review date.
verify: List plans past their review date with no tracking entry.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Record the closure outcome for the plan
sop: Record the outcome as recovered, extended or escalated.
Close the remediation case with the outcome and date.
Done when the closure outcome and date are recorded.
verify: List flags past review date with no recorded action or outcome.
Pass when that list is empty.
